projectTitle: Robust Gradual Domain Adaptation with Stable Pseudo-Labeling
description: Developing robust Gradual Domain Adaptation (GDA) methods that address pseudo-label instability in GOAT by combining an EMA teacher with temperature-scaled pseudo-labels and contrastive learning, improving accuracy and convergence stability across intermediate domains.

projectTitle: Fractional Chromatic Numbers of Random Hypergraph Subgraphs
description: Extended the Mohar–Wu probabilistic framework from graphs to hypergraphs by introducing a weight-based vertex ordering and left-neighbor counts, obtaining high-probability lower bounds on fractional chromatic numbers of random subgraphs and analyzing limitations of high-distance extensions.

projectTitle: Knowledge-Distillation Skill Transfer for Quadruped Locomotion
institution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Apex Lab
description: Designed a knowledge-distillation based skill-transfer mechanism that enables quadruped robots to acquire new navigation policies without catastrophic forgetting, built training pipelines in unstructured environments, and validated robustness, stability, and terrain adaptability.

Analyzed the theoretical behaviors of chain-of-thought reasoning in Transformers by reproducing lower-bound results showing that linear CoT steps allow Transformers to simulate every DFA and bounded-step Turing machine, and examined what structural assumptions are needed to make such mechanisms realistic and learnable.

projectTitle: Theoretical Foundations of Counterfactual Regret Minimization
description: Reconstructed the theory of counterfactual regret minimization in extensive-form games by deriving the decomposition of overall regret into information-set-level counterfactual regrets and re-proving the regret-matching guarantee via Blackwell approachability.

projectTitle: Energy-Based Exploration with EBGANs and Soft Actor-Critic
institution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Apex Lab
description: Developed an energy-based exploration framework that integrates EBGANs with Soft Actor-Critic to estimate state novelty in sparse-reward navigation tasks, deriving an intrinsic reward from an energy maximization view and demonstrating improved exploration efficiency.
